_note: Rules for systems/discord. A public signed-out capture. The /login card's 'Log in with QR Code' panel draws a QR code that encodes a short-lived remote-auth sign-in token, a credential: the code is painted out (a solid fill of its own white tile, inset inside the tile's quiet zone so the ring samples white) in every image that shows it: the QR-panel crop, the auth-card crop and both login screenshots. A recapture hides the code before shooting (HIDE_LOGIN_QR in tools/capture/public/lib.mjs).
